scientific_integrity.central_statement: Sharp fractional spectral-order transition with a general adjacent-ratio iff criterion for affine positive-semidefinite covariance perturbations on every sphere dimension at least two.
scientific_limitations: The general finite admissibility constant is specified exactly as an operator norm, not generally in elementary closed form.
Only affine factors involving x+y are classified; other nonstationary constructions can remain valid.
The negative integral witness implies existence of finite-site negative Gram forms but does not specify an optimal finite site count.
An unindexed prior equivalent, particularly in subscription-only axial covariance literature, cannot be excluded.
No independent audit has been performed.

title: The half-order spectral boundary for affine anisotropy of spherical fractional heat kernels
